cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sunday cancelled again? I taught you to let Mum know before she makes up the spare bed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Work changed my shift. I can't help it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last time it was overtime. You're very good at explaining things to me. Now graduate to telling her yourself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll think I don't want to visit. Could you soften it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Back to the first lesson: you cancel, I apologise. You'll arrange the next visit with her too. Let's see if any of my teaching stuck.

reason: Replace generic teaching tags with specific repeated lessons and practical responsibility that escalates because of B request for continued dependence.
